queries.postgres_any: SELECT id::text AS key, row_to_json(i)::text AS row FROM public.items AS i WHERE id = ANY($1::bigint[])

notes: Client and Linux VM share the Mac CPU. Other development containers remained running.
PostgreSQL data and WAL are on tmpfs. Container memory includes shared memory and cached files; it is not summed process RSS.

measurement_notes: Each client variant runs in a separate process, sequentially. No pgbench is used in this comparison.
Node JSON wraps the same mget call in array_to_json; Go pgx uses binary text[] decoding. All variants parse each row JSON and restore requested positions.
CPU is cgroup usage across an initial/final snapshot window around the timed workload. It includes sampler processes and background PostgreSQL work.
Memory is sampled every 500ms plus endpoints; peaks are sampled peaks, not RSS or an exact maximum. memory.current includes shared memory, tmpfs and page cache.
Raw activity snapshots distinguish PostgreSQL state from wait_event_type; active includes clients waiting on ClientRead/ClientWrite.
Client and server share Mac hardware with other development containers. tmpfs does not represent durable disk I/O.
threads records execution parallelism: Node one event loop; Go GOMAXPROCS, not live OS thread count.
